content.text:
Refusing greens is really common at 28 months. Put a tiny bit of a green on his plate next to something he already likes, and don't comment on it or push him to eat it. It can take a dozen or more calm exposures before he tries it. If you eat it in front of him, that helps too.

Also, I told you before that I couldn't sign kids up for classes. I can try now once you say yes. Want me to look for something for him?
